# Vertex42

> > Vertex42 provides free Excel templates, calendars, calculators, and spreadsheets for personal finance, small business, and project management.

Vertex42 is a comprehensive resource for downloadable templates and tools across Excel, Google Sheets, Microsoft Word, and PDF formats. Founded by Jon Wittwer, the site specializes in business templates, financial calculators, and educational spreadsheet resources.

## Key Topics

- Excel templates
- Google Sheets
- Gantt Chart
- Budget templates
- Invoice templates
- Project management
- Calendar templates
- Financial calculators
- Microsoft Word
- Small business
- Timesheet templates
- Conditional formatting
- Business documents
- Task management
- Personal finance

## Excel Templates & Spreadsheets

- [Free Excel Templates and Spreadsheets](https://www.vertex42.com/ExcelTemplates): Main Excel templates hub featuring budgets, calendars, Gantt charts and business templates
- [20+ Budget Templates for Excel - Vertex42.com](https://www.vertex42.com/ExcelTemplates/budgets.html): 20+ budget templates for Excel, OpenOffice and Google Sheets for personal finance
- [Invoice Templates for Excel](https://www.vertex42.com/ExcelTemplates/invoice-templates.html): Invoice templates for Excel, Google Sheets and OpenOffice for small business billing
- [Timesheets, Timecards, and Payroll Templates for Excel](https://www.vertex42.com/ExcelTemplates/timesheets.html): Timesheet, timecard and payroll templates for Excel, Google Sheets and OpenOffice
- [Business Templates | Small Business Spreadsheets and Forms](https://www.vertex42.com/ExcelTemplates/business-templates.html): Small business spreadsheets and forms including invoices, timesheets and more

## Project Management & Gantt Charts

- [20+ Project Management Templates for Excel | Project Schedules](https://www.vertex42.com/ExcelTemplates/excel-project-management.html): 20+ project management templates with Gantt charts and RACI matrices for Excel
- [Free Gantt Chart Template for Excel](https://www.vertex42.com/ExcelTemplates/excel-gantt-chart.html): Free Gantt chart template for Excel by Jon Wittwer for project task scheduling
- [Gantt Chart Template Pro for Excel](https://www.vertex42.com/ExcelTemplates/gantt-chart-template-pro.html): Gantt Chart Template Pro for Excel and Google Sheets with customization options
- [How to Make a Gantt Chart in Excel - Video Series](https://www.vertex42.com/ExcelTips/how-to-make-a-gantt-chart-in-excel.html): Video tutorial series by Jon Wittwer on creating Gantt charts with conditional formatting

## Calendars & Scheduling

- [Free Calendars and Calendar Templates | Printable Calendars](https://www.vertex42.com/calendars): Free printable calendar templates for Excel, Google Sheets and PDF formats
- [Excel Calendar Template for 2026 and Beyond](https://www.vertex42.com/ExcelTemplates/excel-calendar-template.html): Excel calendar template by Jon Wittwer with theme customization and digital stickers
- [2026 Calendar Templates and Images](https://www.vertex42.com/calendars/2026.html): 2026 calendar templates in Excel, Google Sheets and PDF with holidays
- [Free Printable Calendar - Printable Monthly Calendars](https://www.vertex42.com/calendars/printable-calendars.html): Free printable monthly and yearly calendars in Excel and PDF formats

## Financial Tools & Calculators

- [Free Financial Calculators for Excel](https://www.vertex42.com/Calculators/financial-calculators.html): Financial calculators for mortgage, debt reduction and retirement savings in Excel
